tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads a file from disk within the project root only.

tools.name: read_config_file
tools.description: Reads one of the predefined configuration files.

tools.name: load_remote_file
tools.description: Loads a file identified by a URI.

tools.name: read_file_contents
tools.description: Reads the contents of a file matching a query.

tools.name: read_file_descriptor
tools.description: Reads a file identified by a numeric descriptor.

tools.name: read_file_info
tools.description: Reads basic metadata about a file.

tools.name: get_open_connections
tools.description: Returns the number of open network connections. See also the file-based variant.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Returns the weather forecast for a city.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: Returns the last 100 commits of the repository.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email to the given recipient.

tools.name: run_lint
tools.description: Runs the linter over the given file with default rules.

tools.name: write_log_file
tools.description: Writes a log entry to one of the predefined log files.
